technical_body.primitive: probe response to any probe request — the AP pretends to be every network the client asks about
per-STA SSID pool — accumulate each client's probe history and respond only with that STA's list
technical_body.advantage: reduces the 'karma is loud' fingerprint that modern OSes have learned to detect

pineap_config.ssid_pool: per-client (via SSH-driven hostapd-mana, not stock PineAP)

technical_body.primitive: broadcast union of all seen probes as beacons — catches every STA at once, at the cost of being obvious to a WIDS
beacon a dictionary of common home SSIDs (linksys, xfinitywifi, attwifi, ...) to farm associations

name: Snoopy — geographic tracking via probe correlation

technical_body.primitive: distributed probe-request collectors log seen SSIDs per client MAC; SSID history → likely home/work locations
technical_body.notes: MAC randomization has thinned the yield but preferred-SSID lists remain reidentifying.

name: PineAP passive probe log (passive KARMA-family recon)

technical_body.primitive: PineAP module logs every probe request seen on the second radio; no transmission
eaphammer combines KARMA-style beacon/probe responses with a captive portal + fake RADIUS in one workflow
technical_body.role: The 'modern MANA' — layered attack profile driven from a single CLI

technical_body.primitive: wifite2 falls back to hostapd-mana-based KARMA when other attacks fail
technical_body.note: Not first-choice — use hostapd-mana or eaphammer directly for control.

technical_body.primitive: The Pineapple emits a signal for every STA that associates to its karma/pool; harvesters use this as a live target list

name: KARMA fallback + PMKID capture on associations

technical_body.primitive: Combine hostapd-mana KARMA responder with hcxdumptool listening; associations produce a PMKID even when the STA's PSK does not match — hashcat 22000 candidate list is seeded from the ESSID.
